meta.name: understand-explain
meta.description: Use when you need a deep-dive explanation of a specific file, function, or module in the codebase

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入理解代码库中的任意文件或函数
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要快速理解不熟悉的代码模块
copy.tagline_en: Deep-dive into any file or function in the codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly understand unfamiliar code modules

howto.what: 当你想了解代码库里某个文件、函数或模块时，Claude 会先查项目里预先建好的“知识图谱”（记录代码间关系的清单），再读原始代码，然后用好懂的语言讲清楚：它是干什么的、属于哪一层、依赖谁、被谁依赖、数据怎么流。若图谱缺失，会提示你先运行 /understand。
howto.when: 当你说出要深入解释的代码文件、函数或模块（通常附带路径），例如“解释一下 src/auth/login.ts”时触发。

say.text: 解释一下 src/auth/login.ts 这个文件是干嘛的
say.note: Claude 会查看图谱并读源码来讲解

say.text: 深入讲讲 src/auth/login.ts 里的 verifyToken 函数
say.note: 会定位该函数并分析其调用关系

say.text: 这个模块依赖哪些文件？属于哪一层？
say.note: 会从图谱中提取依赖和分层信息

howto.what_en: When you ask about a file, function, or module, Claude checks the project's pre-built knowledge graph (JSON of relations), reads the source code, and explains plainly: its purpose, layer, dependencies, dependents, and data flow. If missing, prompts you to run /understand first.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a deep-dive explanation of a specific file, function, or module in the codebase, often by naming its path, e.g., 'explain src/auth/login.ts'.

say_en.note: Claude looks up the graph and reads the source

say_en.text: Dive into the verifyToken function in src/auth/login.ts
say_en.note: Locates the function node and analyzes connections

say_en.text: What does this module depend on and which layer is it in?
say_en.note: Extracts dependency and layer info from the graph
